title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Wednesday, 16 September 2026
description: Today: Shanghai AI Lab quietly ships a free 744B-parameter agentic model as businesses give AI narrower, specific jobs; Tony Burke's migration overhaul lands tomorrow while the Plymouth Brethren church faces a parliamentary inquiry; Brisbane ferries face another strike stoppage; and the Gold Coast Suns confirm Ben King's departure as rail closures loom. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
